issues.what: Near-ring detail drops in one step: high-frequency energy about halves while the planet stays sharp and shifts only a few pixels. The same ring patch does not match under any shift within 24 pixels, so the softness reads as a drop rather than a continuous directional streak.
issues.fix: Ease the near-ground blur on with the pull, along the ring motion, and keep the same ring pattern through 3810 to 3817 so the detail does not drop out.

issues.what: The terrain dwell is not on these sheets, about 181 frames. The arrival eases in and the pull-up eases out, but the time at the place is missing, so the stop cannot be confirmed as one unbroken flight through the place.
issues.fix: Add the terrain contact sheet and a consecutive cover across the arrival into it and the departure out of it.
